units.source_text: 薰君的母亲三公主现在静心修行佛法，每月定时念佛，每年举行两次法华八讲，

en.t: Kaoru's mother, the Third Princess, now devoted herself quietly to Buddhist practice, reciting the nenbutsu at set times each month and holding the Lotus Eight Lectures twice each year,

units.source_text: 此外逢时逢节，又举办种种法事，岑寂地度送岁月。

en.t: besides which, whenever seasonal occasions or festivals came around, she held various Buddhist services and passed the months and years in lonely quiet.

units.source_text: 薰君有时赴三条院省亲，三公主赖他照顾，反像仰仗父母荫庇一样。

en.t: Kaoru sometimes went to Sanjo-in to visit his mother, and the Third Princess depended on his care, almost as though she were relying on the protection of her own parents.

units.source_text: 薰君觉得母亲很可怜，颇思常来侍奉。

en.t: Kaoru pitied his mother deeply and often wished that he could come regularly to attend on her.

units.source_text: 然而冷泉院和今上常常召唤他。

en.t: Yet Reizei-in and the reigning emperor often summoned him.

units.source_text: 皇太子及其诸弟也都把他当作亲爱的游戏伴侣，使他不得闲暇，心甚痛苦，恨不得将此一身分为两人。

en.t: The Crown Prince and his younger brothers also treated him as a beloved playmate, leaving him no leisure; this pained him deeply, and he wished he could divide his one body into two people.

units.source_text: 关于自己出生之事，他小时候隐约有所闻知，长大后时时怀疑，心甚不安，然而无人可问。

en.t: As for the circumstances of his birth, he had heard vague hints when he was young, and after growing up he often felt doubtful and deeply uneasy, yet there was no one he could ask.

units.source_text: 在母亲面前呢，他认为即使隐约表示自己有所闻知，也很痛心，所以当然不问。

en.t: In his mother's presence, he thought that even faintly suggesting he had heard something would be painful, so naturally he did not ask.

units.source_text: 他只是一直在忧虑：“究竟为了何事，由于何种宿缘，致使我身带着此种疑虑而出生于世呢？

en.t: He merely went on worrying: "For what reason, and through what karmic bond, was I born into this world carrying such doubts within me?

units.source_text: 善巧太子能问自身而释疑，我也要有此种悟力才好。”

en.t: Prince Zengyo was able to question himself and dispel his doubts; if only I too had that kind of power of insight."

units.source_text: 他这样想，常常自言自语地说出口来。

en.t: Thinking this, he often spoke the words aloud as if talking to himself.
He once composed a poem, saying:
